added: Fuliza tracking: set an overdraft limit per SIM, borrow and repay from Home, and see your net after what you owe
New calm color themes inspired by Tendo: six accents (Blue, Teal, Amber, Rose, Purple, Green) that softly tint the whole app in both light and dark mode
changed: Accent picker redesigned with mode-matched color swatches
SIM card colors now match the new accent palette

added: Update Budgeter from inside the app: new versions download and install over your current one
Budgeter checks for a new version once a day when you open it
changed: Release notes on GitHub now come from the in-app changelog
APK builds are stable and finish reliably on CI again
Stats charts are lighter custom views: the ring shows the total in the middle and the bar chart is simpler and consistent with the rest of the app
fixed: Stats screen opened to a blank page and froze the app
Progress ring: small categories drew over their neighbors; tiny slices now merge into Other and every slice keeps its own space
Settings showed 'Failed to download remote update' right after a check when nothing new was available; it now says you're up to date
Release APKs are properly signed so Android can install them
